initial_pressure_compatibility.assessment: non-negligible (>=1% of p_a_sep); reported, not forced to zero
initial_pressure_compatibility.note: p_c(t0) is JWL at R_c(t0)=R_sep+u_c,sep*epsilon; p_a,sep is the matched air pressure. They are different states at slightly different positions/times.

clock.reference_state: CJ detonation state at V_cj = rho_TNT/rho_CJ
clock.time_formula_basis: uniform CJ detonation from the charge centre at constant D; the CJ radius R_cj=R0 V_cj^(1/3) is reached at that time. This is an approximation whose physical basis still needs confirmation against the deck/initiation model
clock.surface_arrival_role: R0/D is recorded as a separate surface-arrival reference only; it is not used as t_cj and not used as the model origin
clock.d3plot_clock_relation: frame times are used as recorded by the extraction (physical seconds); no t_sep or R0/D shift is applied and no event is aligned to a theoretical time. R_b(t0) must exist on that same axis; the shared origin of the model clock and the d3plot clock is not verified here

provenance.shock_model: strong-shock approximation (documented; exact Hugoniot is a separate cross-check)
provenance.R_sep: calculated from uniform-sphere mass conservation, R0 V_sep^(1/3)
provenance.t_sep: calculated from the uniform-sphere CJ-radius expansion integral; R0/D is only a separate surface-arrival reference
provenance.Rc0_Rs0: first-order displacement approximation, not a numerical evolution
missing: R_b(t0) is a data-side quantity and is not supplied by this module
the material card's C/JWL provenance must be checked against the deck

notes: V is the dimensionless relative volume rho_TNT/rho_product; the mass specific volume is 1/rho and is not the same quantity
the uniform-sphere expansion integral starts at the CJ radius R_cj=R0 V_cj^(1/3), at t_cj=R_cj/D; the surface-arrival time R0/D is reported separately as a reference, not used as t_ref
air Hugoniot model: strong; the other model is available for a documented mass/velocity cross-check

the same initial state is used over the shocked layer; the difference between p_c(t0) and the thin-layer p_a,sep is reported with its actual relative size by CaseData.initial_compatibility(), not dismissed as O(epsilon) and not forced to zero
t_cj=R_cj/D is a uniform-CJ approximation and is marked unverified; the shared origin of this model clock and the d3plot time axis is not assumed
